VU Artificial Intelligence combines computing and mathematics with human cognition and responsible AI. Its general bachelor includes programming, intelligent systems, machine learning, knowledge and data, computational human behaviour and social applications, alongside restricted choices, open academic study space and an individual AI research project.

UCR offers three qualified directions: hybrid intelligence and cognition; AI algorithms and computer systems; and AI methods with health and behaviour foundations. Each contains substantial actual AI methods. Mathematics supports the computational sequence, while psychology, neuroscience and health courses supply domain knowledge. These compositions leave gaps in dedicated interaction design, computational behaviour modelling, text mining and the VU project sequence. They do not promise clinical AI validation, social-robot construction or an equivalent independent thesis.

Academic year: 2026–2027

External pathway: General AI pathway; no optional specialisation

The general route comprises54EC compulsory year-one courses plus one6EC restricted choice;42EC compulsory year-two courses plus three6EC restricted choices;24EC prescribed year-three project/ethics/research-design plus one6EC restricted choice and30EC open academic profiling. First-listed eligible choices are shown; options and optional specialisations are not stacked. Project entry requires passed introductory Python6EC and at least90EC of AI bachelor curricular courses. The individual project requires a supervisor/topic, literature study, thesis and annual seminar poster presentation; assessment is work50%, report40%, presentation10%. Research Design accompanies it and requires four on-campus working groups with pass/fail participation; remote or substitute assessment is unavailable. Diagnostic English testing and required refresher are mandatory without extra EC. BSA ordinarily requires42EC first-year credits, subject to exceptions. Individual open choices require prior board approval, at least12EC level300 and at most6EC level100. Foreign choices may additionally include at most one6EC master course, not reusable later. Eligible university/listed minors are exempt from prior approval, but AI students may not enrol in the university Data Science or Basics of AI minors. Course-manual attendance and thesis/placement regulations apply. The general route claims no specialisation credential. The project normally runs in periods5–6. Its topic must be recorded in OnStage before period5 starts; otherwise the project moves to the following academic year. Modelling Human Behaviour requires on-campus lectures/practicals and assessment components of at least5.5 each.

What this comparison shows

A curriculum-level comparison of Artificial Intelligence at Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam with 3 illustrative UCR study compositions.

CLOSEST UCR MATCH
Hybrid intelligence and human cognition

Combines programming, machine learning, logic and agent decision making with cognitive science, perception and human behaviour. Ethics and philosophy of mind frame how intelligent systems interact with people; this is a broad AI programme rather than a replica of the VU thesis and project sequence. General or biological courses supply their stated foundations; no specialised human–robot interaction, clinical AI, computational language project or independent AI thesis is guaranteed.

ADDITIONAL UCR OPTION
AI algorithms and computer systems

Emphasises intelligent agents, machine learning and neural networks alongside software development, algorithms, databases, numerical methods and computing infrastructure. Human interaction and ethics remain foundations, but the additional curriculum develops technical computer-science depth. General or biological courses supply their stated foundations; no specialised human–robot interaction, clinical AI, computational language project or independent AI thesis is guaranteed.

ADDITIONAL UCR OPTION
AI methods with health and behaviour foundations

Combines machine learning, neural networks, planning, optimisation, computer vision and robotics with mathematical preparation and substantive health, physiology and human-behaviour foundations. The health courses provide domain knowledge; they do not guarantee medical triage systems, clinical validation or social-robot projects.

Important limitation

This is a curriculum comparison. A UCR composition is not the same disciplinary degree and does not by itself establish a professional qualification or automatic eligibility for a particular master’s programme.

The VU individual AI project includes literature, research, a thesis and a poster presentation. UCR course projects do not automatically provide that supervised independent project. Optional independent research is additional to the displayed 180 EC and requires separate approval.
